verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a paid autonomous research SaaS, so an API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only the web product: topic input, credits and report generation. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
